representation_fit.evidence: Brief cell is complete × consequential-flow: one high-consequence workflow, zero-mistake completion, recovery/confirm on irreversible steps. The app is a dedicated runbook executor for a payment primary-DB switchover — 3-phase/9-step map, per-step checks, 不可逆 badges, undo windows, manual recovery procedures, audit log, and a verdict screen whose 失误/偏差 counters operationalize '零失误走完全程' (screenshots/1280x860.png; source/screenshots/11-verdict-zero-mistake.png; data.js:11-15, app.js:454-491). Shape match (high hierarchy, single instance, low density) is exact.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen's center stage is the current step card (PRE-01: read-only panel, two checks, transcript-and-verify input) with breadcrumb '阶段一 · 预检与准备 · 第 1 / 9 步' (screenshots/1280x860.png; app.js:339); header states the goal '目标：零失误走完全程' (index.html:16) with '0 / 9 步' progress top-center; the left map highlights the active step with a pulsing dot (styles.css:116).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy (not human-judged): title, subtitle, phase/step breadcrumb, risk badge, and the red gating hint '尚未满足：2 项核查未勾选；校验码未誊录核对' (screenshots/1280x860.png; app.js:348-350) convey what/where/next in seconds; irreversible steps are flagged inline in both map and stage (app.js:236, styles.css:126-130).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (current step) is the default view at load — 0 clicks (screenshots/1280x860.png); any already-executed step is 1 click away via map buttons (app.js:232-237, 567-571); future steps are locked previews, which is the correct structure for a zero-mistake consequential flow rather than friction (app.js:443-451). No menus or modes.

context_loss.evidence: Single page, three permanent panes — stage swaps in place while map and audit log persist (index.html:32-42); restart is modal-confirmed (index.html:44-53, app.js:578-581); completed/locked steps remain inspectable as recaps (app.js:416-423, 384-404); view auto-returns to the current step after each mutation (app.js:72-76). No action abandons state.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly: header (progress + 不可逆/失误/偏差/timer chips + restart), step map, stage, audit log (index.html:11-42). Each maps to the job — 失误/偏差 chips are the brief's success criteria made visible (app.js:202-203), the audit log is the run's receipt ('完整审计日志见右侧', app.js:489). No idle or decorative controls in either viewport.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4 of 7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16, target_invalid:false). Partial mitigations visible in source: :focus-visible outline (styles.css:33), aria-labels on map/stage/log (index.html:33-40), dialog aria on modal (index.html:45), label/input association (app.js:269). But 16px checkboxes (styles.css:177) and 10–11.5px muted/faint text (styles.css:62, 95, 122, 323; --faint #5d6b80 on dark, styles.css:10) are consistent with the target-size, type-size and contrast failures.

frontend_rework.evidence: Layout is defect-free in evidence: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass and both screenshots render cleanly at 1280x860 and 1440x900. However the same receipt shows 4 failures implying rework before acceptance (measurement-summary.json:13-16), and one structural focus defect is corroborated in source: checking a checkbox or ack re-renders the entire stage innerHTML, dropping focus mid-task (app.js:530-535 → app.js:322-364), consistent with the a11y.focus_order fail.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径' is covered end-to-end: confirmation-phrase transcription before any irreversible execute (data.js:115,144; app.js:87-108); 10s/8s undo windows with live countdown and one-click undo (data.js:102,131; app.js:110-117, 367-382; source/screenshots/05-undo-window-live.png); post-lock manual recovery HP-01/HP-02 with phrase re-confirmation, deviation counting, and a reverse-order recovery guard (data.js:104-114,133-143; app.js:52,63,131-147,384-404; source/screenshots/06-locked-recovery-path.png, 07-manual-recovery-hp01.png); plus gate-blocked safe stop and both verdict paths (source/screenshots/09,10,11).

defects_observed: a11y.focus_order fail (measurement-summary.json checks); structurally consistent with whole-stage innerHTML re-render on checkbox/ack toggle dropping focus (app.js:530-535, app.js:322-364)
a11y.target_size fail (measurement-summary.json checks); 16px checkboxes (styles.css:177) and small badges/pills (styles.css:126-130, 202-210)
type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json checks); 10–11.5px type sizes in permanent UI (styles.css:62, 95, 122, 323)
missing_evidence: Sanitized receipt lists failing check ids but not the specific elements, contrast ratios, target dimensions, or font sizes that failed, so the exact rework scope cannot be localized beyond source corroboration

The seven browser checks cover the initial page only; interactive states (undo window, locked recovery, blocked gate, verdicts) are evidenced by screenshots shipped inside the package, not by independent checks
scores.overall_note: This package implements the consequential-flow cell almost literally: a single 9-step high-consequence runbook (payment DB switchover) with a persistent flow map, an always-current step stage, an audit-log receipt pane, and a verdict screen whose 失误/偏差 counters restate the brief's zero-mistake success criterion (screenshots/1280x860.png, 1440x900.png; data.js:11-15). The acceptance seed is not merely represented but enforced: irreversible steps require read-and-ack of the rollback plan, phrase transcription, a timed undo window, and a post-lock manual recovery procedure with its own phrase confirmation and reverse-order guard (app.js:87-147; source/screenshots/03,05,06,07,09,11 show each state working). Layout is clean at both viewports with all three layout checks passing. The clear weak spot is objective accessibility/typography evidence: 4 of 7 receipt checks fail (contrast, focus order, target size, minimum type size; measurement-summary.json:13-16), with plausible structural corroboration in small type sizes and full-stage re-renders that drop focus. Task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind package, and model judgment of the screens stands in for human preference here.
